noHeaterScripts: Configure the heater On and Off scripts
entityHint: Select the fan or heater to control.
typeHint: Sets the card icon and active color.
labelHint: Leave empty to use the Home Assistant name.
heaterOnScriptHint: Home Assistant script that turns the heater on.
heaterOffScriptHint: Home Assistant script that turns the heater off.
heaterStateHint: Select the entity that is on while the heater is running. If left empty, the card remembers the last command.
